symptoms_en: Nymphs and adults suck sap from pods, stems, leaves and buds; pods show pale-yellow patches and brown feeding scars and become shrivelled with small seeds.
symptoms_hi: शिशु और वयस्क फलियों, तनों, पत्तियों और कलियों का रस चूसते हैं; फलियों पर हल्के पीले धब्बे और भूरे निशान बनते हैं और वे सिकुड़ जाती हैं, दाने छोटे रह जाते हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of black and green gram
symptoms_en.quote: Nymphs and adults suck the sap and cause substantial damage to pods and also to stem, leaves and flower buds. Infested pods show pale-yellow patches and dark brown feeding scars on pods. Shriveled pods, small seeds are results of severe damage.

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of black and green gram
management_en.quote: Physical collection of bugs in a vessel with water and oil to reduce the population

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: For sucking pests (like thrips and whitefly) in the early stage: Spray Neemastra @ 200 litres per acre
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Control of pink bollworm and jassids: Spray 5–7 litres of Brahmastra in 200 litres of water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Collect the bugs by hand in a vessel of water and oil.
management_hi: खटमल हाथ से पानी और तेल के बर्तन में इकट्ठा करें।
source_notes: AI research (2026-10-07). Organic and cultural steps only are listed under management; chemical sprays in the sources are left out. Escalation advice is not sourced for most pests yet (TODO(agronomist)). NITI's sucking-pest recipes are matched to the bugs.
